name: Mantons Creek Estate
signature: Four adults-only vineyard suites with on-estate Italian dining — the most under-indexed southern Red Hill wine-country stay
editorNote:
Mantons Creek is positioned two minutes from Ten Minutes by Tractor and three minutes from Montalto (day-only), which makes it the strongest base for the southern Red Hill winery circuit that does not require driving between your bed and your glass. The four adults-only suites are Mediterranean-style with private balconies over the vineyard, espresso makers, and designer toiletries.

The decisive feature is Quattro Restaurant on site — Italian, breakfast through dinner — which means the stay has the same on-estate logic as Polperro or Crittenden without requiring you to leave the property for a meal. It is the most under-indexed entry in the Peninsula villa category: consistently appearing in resort-broker and Expedia data but almost invisible in editorial coverage.

Suite format rather than standalone villa, but the vineyard setting and on-estate dining earn it a place in this category.
whyWeGo: On-estate Italian dining plus two minutes from Ten Minutes by Tractor — the southern Red Hill base that does not require a car between your bed and your glass.
ifOnlyOneThing: Book for a midweek stay — fewer day-trippers at the adjacent cellar doors and more table availability at Quattro.
